question: Support a 9.9% Washington income tax on individuals earning over $1 million a year
note: Unsponsored DHM regular WA survey (republished Seattle Times story); n=500 per DHM blog https://www.dhmresearch.com/are-washingtonians-finally-ready-for-a-state-income-tax/ Tagged sen:toptax as concept match (tax on the wealthiest).

question: Vote on I-645 to repeal WA's tax on income over $1M (ballot summary without budget-impact language)
note: Reverse-direction question: sup = % voting NO on repeal (keep tax), opp = % voting yes on repeal. Split sample of 800; half-sample with budget-impact language gave 57% keep / 35% repeal. Tagged sen:toptax as concept match (tax on the wealthiest).

Opposition not reported.
